payload.title: X hashtags from X data as well as our knowledge base
payload.description: Owner (Ryan, 2026-11-21): we need hashtags for marketing. Today the candidates are the Story's accepted concepts ranked by use on our own site, and the drafting model picks up to two; nothing reads X. Research (X docs read 2026-11-21): no official hashtag suggestion endpoint; counts/recent costs $0.005 per request (7-day volume per hashtag); recent search $0.005 per post returned with entities.hashtags and public_metrics; trends list only topics with 1,000+ posts a day; our own posts' non_public_metrics.url_link_clicks are readable for 30 days at $0.001 per owned read. A post with a URL costs $0.20. Terms: the Developer Policy forbids measuring X usage for benchmarking, competitive or commercial purposes (internal hashtag choice is not addressed); the declared use case binds the app; posting to trending topics for visibility is not allowed, so every tag must fit the Story. Design: our concepts propose, X co-occurrence adds, X volume ranks, the model picks, our click data teaches.
